entries.measured: Every in-house check read this grade as a MATCH, because every check decoded Muhammad's file the same wrong way. His ad3_v6hd.mp4 carries NO colour tags; ffmpeg's scaler decodes an untagged file with the BT.601 matrix, while VLC and browsers decode untagged HD as BT.709. The grade LUT (zlut.py) was fitted to the BT.601 reading. At 16 matched talk frames, same scene pixels, both decoded by ffmpeg default: his RGB mean 116/94/75 vs ours 112/91/70, skin 134/88/58 vs 131/85/53 -- a 'match'. Decoded as a player shows them (both BT.709): his all-pixel RGB 121/99/80 sat 0.385 vs ours 114/92/71 sat 0.406; his highlights p95 250 vs ours 238. Ours is darker, warmer/muddier (blue ~9 short) and dimmer in the whites.
entries.notes: A reference-colour-fidelity row must decode the reference with the matrix a PLAYER uses (BT.709 for untagged HD), never ffmpeg's untagged default. Master preserved at the path above; render 9, watch pass sha 042c9f48c52e.

I really like this graphic at 4:40. I think that really helped illustrate things

Overall I think this was a solid first attempt but there are some significant changes that we need:
